records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 — the host format regex limits TLDs to 2-5 characters, rejecting valid newer gTLDs like .software and .technology
records.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the validation `validates_format_of :host, with: /\.[a-z]{2,5}.../i` explicitly restricts the TLD portion to 2–5 letters. This will reject legitimate domains with longer TLDs (e.g. `.software`, `.technology`), and this constraint is newly introduced by the diff (previous SiteSetting-based host list parsing did not impose this 2–5 TLD length limit).

Routes also add `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`. This creates a misleading/dead API surface (PUT exists but performs no update), though

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:44-52 — the delete action's destroyRecord() promise has no .catch(popupAjaxError), so a failed delete silently leaves the row on screen
records.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete action calls this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...) without any .catch(popupAjaxError) (unlike save(), which does catch). If the delete request fails, the rejection is unhandled and the UI won’t notify the user or remove the row, matching the finding.
